tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all tests pass
tasks.description:
Run the complete Vitest test suite to confirm all existing tests pass. Execute the following commands in order:
1. npx vitest run
2. npx tsc --noEmit

Report any failing tests with their error output.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run exits code 0 with all tests passing
npx tsc --noEmit exits code 0 with no type errors
